### Run160 regulatory addendum — Ripple National Trust Bank final OCC approval reconciled (2026-11-15)

A new primary-source reconciliation resolves the earlier uncertainty over Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB).

- The OCC Corporate Applications Search entry for control number `2025-Charter-342347` identifies the application as a new national bank charter under a trust-bank transaction form, proposed charter number 25364. It records receipt on July 2, 2025, approval on December 12, 2025, and **Consummated/Effective on October 26, 2026**: https://apps.occ.gov/CAS/home/details?FilingID=RjzoD2gxmYOv&FilingSubtypeID=1093&FilingTypeID=2
- Ripple's October 26, 2026 first-party announcement says the OCC granted final approval. It lists the approved activities as managing segregated RLUSD reserves, acting as collateral trustee for RLUSD holders, and providing fiduciary digital-asset custody: https://ripple.com/ripple-press/ripple-receives-final-occ-approval-to-establish-national-trust-bank/
- The OCC Interpretations & Decisions index still displays Conditional Approval 1359 dated December 12, 2025. That is the original conditional-approval letter. It does not negate the later OCC CAS record of consummation/effectiveness or Ripple's October 26 final-approval announcement. Treat the I&D index as an incomplete/lagging status view for this application.
- **Issuer boundary:** Ripple's release explicitly says RLUSD continues to be issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company (SCTC), Ripple's NYDFS-regulated limited-purpose trust company. RNTB adds federal OCC supervision and the stated reserve/collateral-trustee/custody roles; RNTB is not the RLUSD issuer.
- **Operational boundary:** final charter approval and consummation/effectiveness are verified. Ripple says fiduciary custody authority applies upon opening; actual operational launch, customer balances, transactions and XRP purchase/settlement volumes were not established by these sources.
- This is a regulatory/institutional adoption event, not evidence of incremental XRP spot demand. Raw HTTP bytes and SHA-256 receipts were not captured, so the event remains excluded from receipt-backed model features.

Source hierarchy: OCC Corporate Applications Search (regulator filing status), Ripple first-party final-approval announcement, and the OCC I&D index (original conditional letter). The structured reconciliation is appended to the Run160 audit JSON.


### Run160 institutional-capital addendum — Evernorth, Ripple and SBI (primary SEC/SBI records)

New primary filings materially improve the “actual capital” ledger.

**Evernorth XRP holdings and closing consideration**
- Evernorth's October 30, 2026 SEC S-1 states approximately **473 million XRP held as of October 9, 2026**. SBI Holdings' November 2 presentation independently reports approximately 473 million XRP and identifies Evernorth as an SBI investee listed on Nasdaq on October 12.
- The SEC S-1 states that $214.1 million in private-placement cash was used to buy **84,365,876 XRP**. That cash purchase is included in the approximately 473 million XRP holding; do not count the $214.1 million cash and the acquired XRP as two separate additions.
- The Q3 10-Q states aggregate closing gross cash proceeds of approximately **$272.6 million**: $224.6 million from private-placement investments plus $48.0 million released from the SPAC trust account, before transaction expenses. Investors also contributed approximately **388,910,554 XRP in kind**.
- The 473 million XRP total is approximately consistent with 388.91 million in-kind XRP plus 84.366 million purchased with cash. The XRP contributed in kind is not fiat cash and the SPAC trust release is not a new XRP market purchase.
- The Q3 10-Q reports 346,284,972 XRP as of September 30, but a subsequent-event line reports 346,484,972 XRP transferred to Pathfinder after the business combination, a 200,000-XRP discrepancy. Preserve it unresolved; do not silently normalize it.

**Post-closing actual cash versus financing capacity**
- On October 13, Evernorth issued $30.0 million principal of 4% convertible senior PIK notes due 2031 and received approximately $29.0 million net after a $1.0 million advisor fee. Classify as debt, not equity; the filing does not establish that the proceeds were used to buy XRP.
- Between October 12 and November 9, holders exercised 3,073,366 warrants at $11.50, and Evernorth issued the same number of shares for **$35.3 million gross cash proceeds**. 8,666,279 warrants remained. This is actual gross equity cash, but the filing does not establish XRP purchases with it.
- The Cantor committed equity facility allows up to 5,218,935 shares at 97% of the applicable VWAP. Its resale registration became effective October 30; a non-refundable $0.5 million commitment fee was due. The company chooses whether to issue purchase notices, and proceeds depend on actual share sales. Treat the ELOC as capacity, not cash received; no draw/purchase amount was established in the reviewed filing.
- The 10-Q's September 30 pre-closing historical position included $91,397 unrestricted cash, a $10.0 million net working-capital deficit, $185.6 million accumulated deficit, $273.2 million nine-month operating loss and $271.0 million digital-asset impairment. It reported $32.9 million nine-month net loss after a $240.3 million non-cash gain on refundable investor advances. These are pre-closing historical figures, not the post-closing cash balance. The 10-Q also reported no revenue and a $3.56 million payable to Pathfinder.

**SBI ownership denominator reconciliation**
- SBI Holdings' November 2 presentation (page 51) reports **36.1% voting rights** and **20.5% economic interest** in Evernorth. SBI explicitly says voting rights are calculated against Class A shares, while economic interest is calculated against total Class A and Class C shares.
- Evernorth's October 30 S-1 reports a **39.9% SBI Group Ownership Percentage** as of October 9 and defines it as Class A and Class B shares beneficially held by SBI Group Holders divided by Outstanding Voting Shares. It is also a contractual maximum-ownership restriction. SBI Group Holders include SBI Venture Fund 2023A, SBI Venture Fund 2023B, SBI PE Holdings Co., Ltd. and SBI Holdings USA, Inc., each controlled by SBI.
- The 39.9% SEC contractual metric/cap is not interchangeable with SBI's 36.1% voting-rights and 20.5% economic-interest figures. The dates and denominators differ. Warrant exercises after October 9 may change the share denominator, but a full cap-table bridge was not established; do not assert that warrants alone explain the difference.

**Implication**
Evernorth is a real institutional XRP treasury with approximately 473 million XRP, a direct SBI group ownership position, Ripple's XRP contribution, actual post-close note and warrant proceeds, and an equity-line capacity. It is not evidence that all those cash proceeds became XRP spot purchases. For flow modeling, keep cash subscriptions, cash-to-XRP purchases, in-kind XRP, SPAC trust release, debt, warrant exercises and undrawn equity capacity as separate event types.

Primary sources:
- SEC S-1: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2092592/000162828026068609/xrpn-20261030.htm
- SEC Q3 Form 10-Q: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2092592/000162828026073871/xrpn-20260930.htm
- SBI Holdings 1H FY2026 presentation (Nov. 2, 2026): https://www.sbigroup.co.jp/english/investors/disclosure/presentation/pdf/261102presentations.pdf

Raw SEC/PDF response bytes and SHA-256 receipts were not captured in this web research pass. These facts are primary-source research, not yet receipt-backed model features.

## Institutional network update: three separate OCC trust banks

The OCC CAS records three separate national trust banks as consummated/effective:

- Coinbase National Trust Company, charter 25390, effective November 6, 2026. Coinbase says the charter expands fiduciary custody under federal oversight; it is not a commercial bank or retail-deposit institution. [OCC CAS](https://apps.occ.gov/CAS/home/details?FilingID=3RAoRRek6o4j&FilingSubtypeID=1093&FilingTypeID=2), [Coinbase announcement](https://www.coinbase.com/blog/sitemap.xml).
- Ripple National Trust Bank, charter 25364, effective October 26, 2026. Ripple's stated scope includes segregated RLUSD reserve management, collateral-trustee services and fiduciary digital-asset custody. RLUSD remains issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, LLC. [OCC CAS](https://apps.occ.gov/CAS/home/details?FilingID=RjzoD2gxmYOv&FilingSubtypeID=1093&FilingTypeID=2).
- First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A. / Circle National Trust, charter 25361, effective July 24, 2026. Circle describes fiduciary custody; reserve management is a planned future capability, not assumed live. [OCC CAS](https://apps.occ.gov/CAS/home/details?FilingID=D79Z71vmerN8&FilingSubtypeID=1093&FilingTypeID=2), [Circle announcement](https://investor.circle.com/news/news-details/2026/Circle-Receives-Final-OCC-Approval-to-Establish-National-Trust-Bank/default.aspx).

These are separate entities and charters, not a shared bank or direct three-way partnership. They establish a regulated custody/reserve-management competitive layer; they do not establish XRP purchases or XRP settlement volume.

Additional relationships retained:
- Coinbase added RLUSD to Prime, Exchange and retail on October 28, with XRPL, Base and Ethereum deposits/withdrawals; Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support was described as future/coming, not live. - SBI VC Trade's RLUSD distribution in Japan remains separate from SBIC East/Central/West; Circle SBI Japan K.K. is a separate 50/50 SBI/Circle joint venture.
- BNY's XRP/RLUSD custody and RLUSD reserve-custody relationship with Ripple remain distinct from exploratory tokenized trade-finance work.

Circle's September 17, 2026 SEC Form 8-K establishes that Binance purchased **1,237,011 newly issued Circle Class A shares at $80.84**, producing **$100M gross proceeds to Circle** in a private placement. ### SBI Group, Circle, USDC, JPYSC and Arc

Circle's August 5 validator announcement names **SBI Group** among Arc's founding validators and quotes Yoshitaka Kitao as Chairman, President and CEO of SBI Holdings. This supports group-level attribution to SBI Holdings, but the exact legal validator subsidiary is not identified.

Circle's September 16 Arc launch material states:
- SBI VC Trade became the first and only company in Japan to distribute USDC in March 2025.
- JPYSC is a trust-type yen stablecoin issued by SBI Shinsei Trust.
- SBI Group intends to leverage USDC and JPYSC on Arc.

- Circle names more than 100 applications and more than 100 institutional/ecosystem builders at launch; these are company-reported adoption figures, not independently verified XRP settlement volume.

Circle's native USDC has also been live on XRPL since June 12, 2025, through Circle Mint and APIs without bridging. That is a direct technical deployment on XRPL, not proof of a commercial partnership with Ripple. USDC and RLUSD can coexist on XRPL; not every stablecoin payment requires XRP.

This produces a more accurate relationship graph:
- SBI Group ↔ Circle: Circle SBI Japan K.K., USDC distribution through SBI VC Trade, Arc validator participation and JPYSC/USDC strategy.
- SBI Group ↔ Ripple: SBI VC Trade RLUSD distribution in Japan, SBI Ripple Asia and Evernorth/SBI ownership relationships.
- Circle ↔ Ripple/XRPL: native USDC on XRPL, while Circle's separate Arc network competes/complements as another institutional payment rail.

The November 13 Form 424B3 supplement attaches Evernorth's September 30 Form 10-Q and explicitly states that the financial statements describe **pre-business-combination** financial condition and nominal capitalization. Therefore, the September 30 $91,397 cash balance, $341.9M digital-asset accounting balance, $524.3M refundable investor advances and $271.0M nine-month impairment are not current post-close financials. The refundable advances were settled through equity issuance at the October 9 closing.

The supplement registers potential resale of 73,688,162 Class A shares: 19,102,635 already-issued Class A shares, up to 31,392,746 Class C conversions, up to 22,953,128 Pathfinder unit exchanges/redemptions and 239,653 Sponsor Warrant shares. Evernorth says it receives no proceeds from selling-securityholder resales except proceeds from Sponsor Warrant exercises. This is potential secondary share supply, not fresh issuer capital and not an XRP treasury sale.

Post-close events disclosed in the filing include $29.0M net convertible-note cash proceeds; 3,073,366 warrant exercises producing $35.3M gross proceeds; 8,666,279 warrants remaining; a 5,218,935-share ELOC capacity with a $500,000 commitment fee; and a 346,484,972-XRP transfer to Pathfinder. ELOC capacity is not cash drawn. The company-reported 473M-XRP treasury and planned Q4 institutional strategies with Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo are announced treasury/deployment plans; actual deployment balances, realized yield and revenue are not established by the reviewed filing.

The correct capital ledger keeps cash proceeds, XRP purchases, in-kind contributions, debt, warrant cash, undrawn ELOC capacity, secondary resales and XRP sales separate. Do not double-count cash used to purchase XRP.

### Evernorth — the 200,000-XRP difference is resolved
The November 13 SEC filing provides the missing component: delayed funding investors committed 200,000 XRP for delivery at closing. The 200,000-XRP difference between the September 30 balance and the October 9 Pathfinder transfer is therefore explained, not an unexplained discrepancy.

The complete XRP reconciliation is:
- 84,365,876 XRP purchased with $214,049,995 of advance cash.
- 261,919,096 XRP in private-placement subscriptions, comprising 211,319,096 XRP from RippleWorks through Arrington XRP Capital Fund, 50,000,000 XRP from a Ripple-affiliated contributor entity, and 600,000 XRP from advance-funding investors.
- 200,000 XRP from delayed-funding investors delivered at closing.
- 126,791,458 XRP contributed directly by Ripple to Pathfinder.
- Total: **473,276,430 XRP**.

The arithmetic bridges:
- Pre-close holdings: 84,365,876 + 261,919,096 = 346,284,972 XRP.
- Post-close Pathfinder transfer: 346,284,972 + 200,000 = 346,484,972 XRP.
- In-kind total: 261,919,096 + 200,000 + 126,791,458 = 388,910,554 XRP.
- Total XRP: 346,484,972 + 126,791,458 = 473,276,430 XRP.

Capital must remain categorized:
- Gross closing cash proceeds were $272.6M: $224.6M private-placement cash plus $48.0M SPAC trust release, before expenses.
- The $214.05M used to purchase 84.366M XRP is already inside the gross closing cash and must not be added again.
- The $10.5M delayed cash commitment is part of the private-placement funding.
- The October 13 convertible note generated $29.0M net from $30.0M principal after a $1.0M fee; it is 4% senior unsecured PIK debt due 2031, with general corporate use including possible XRP acquisition.
- Cash warrant exercises between October 12 and November 9 generated $35.3M gross from 3,073,366 exercises; 8,666,279 remained. No filing evidence establishes that these proceeds purchased XRP.
- The Cantor ELOC permits up to 5,218,935 shares at 97% of applicable VWAP. Registration became effective October 30; the $500K commitment fee is not a draw, and no actual draw was established.
- SBI's 2025 announcement of a $200M cash commitment and an expected raise above $1B is not proof that the full amount was realized. The SEC filing identifies SBI-affiliated investors and a 39.9% Class A ownership threshold but does not individually reconcile SBI's cash contribution. ### Correction — main-branch Coinbase paper trader is an actual unapproved paper-trading path

A direct comparison of the current main script and integration script changes the risk assessment materially.

**Main script:** `scripts/coinbase_paper_trader.py`, blob `b38ab435f575b6037f05fa8e9ea00fd487d2d9eb`.

- No `BARROT_PAPER_TRADER_APPROVED=YES` gate.
- No persisted-position product-identity validation.
- `load_state()` silently substitutes a fresh default state when persisted JSON cannot be read.
- Fetches live public Coinbase ticker/trade data, sends a buy/sell/hold prompt to Groq, mutates a simulated position, and writes paper-trading state/logs.
- Main workflow `.github/workflows/coinbase-paper-trader.yml` is manually dispatchable, hardcodes `BTC-USD`, and attempts to commit those state/log files to main without a typed approval or expected-main-SHA gate.

Main's persisted state was read without mutation:

- Cash: $9,009.94.
- Open position: 0.012445158497236623.
- `position_product`: null.
- Average entry: $80,436.84.
- Trade count: 126.

The main script does not reject that unidentified open position before using the configured BTC-USD product. A manual dispatch could therefore continue an unidentified simulated position as BTC-USD. It is paper trading, not real-money exchange execution, but it violates the user's no-paper-trade-without-specific-approval rule. No dispatch occurred.

**Integration containment:** `scripts/coinbase_paper_trader.py`, blob `866d8695f0e7787db397179e9d3be648061e8b1f`, requires `BARROT_PAPER_TRADER_APPROVED=YES` before reading mutable state or making provider calls, validates the persisted position's product identity, rejects invalid/corrupt state rather than silently resetting it, and the integration workflow requires typed YES plus the expected main SHA. Its repository permission is read-only and outputs are artifacts only. No paper-trader workflow was dispatched.

## Run171 institutional and market supplement — JPYSC public-chain status, SBI/BlackRock/SMFG, RLUSD and Circle rails

### JPYSC: service balances are not XRP float

SBI VC Trade's November 2 release reports a JPYSC lending balance above ¥10B and total handled balance above ¥30B. The total is defined as on-chain balance plus lending balance. The three lending courses then offered were 3% for 168 days, 2.5% for 84 days and 2% for 28 days. These are JPYSC service balances, not XRP capital flows, XRP collateral or evidence of XRP purchases. [SBI VC Trade, November 2](https://www.sbigroup.co.jp/news/2026/1102_16704.html).

The current official JPYSC product page says the network label is Ethereum, but external deposits and withdrawals are not supported; public-chain circulation remains contingent on legal/tax treatment and supervisory confirmation. No official XRPL issuer was found. XRPL validators previously warned about fake JPYSC tickers. Do not count JPYSC as freely transferable XRPL supply. [SBI VC Trade JPYSC page](https://www.sbivc.co.jp/jpysc) · [validator warning](https://thecryptobasic.com/2026/06/25/abdul-sbi-lauxrp-ledger-validators-issue-warning-over-fake-jpysc-tokens/).

The JPYSC lending product is a customer-to-SBI VC Trade consumer-loan contract, not a bank deposit. SBI's own risk disclosure says borrowed JPYSC is not segregated under the cited structure, may be on-lent, is not covered by deposit insurance, and may not be fully returned if SBI VC Trade fails. This is a material counterparty-risk and collateral-classification distinction. [SBI VC Trade risk disclosure](https://www.sbivc.co.jp/jpysc).
